mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a mild CYP3A4 inducer that may reduce candesartan exposure, and combined use increases orthostatic hypotension and syncope risk through additive effects on blood pressure and CNS depression.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely during initiation and titration of eslicarbazepine; consider candesartan dose adjustment if blood pressure control becomes inadequate, and counsel patient on fall/syncope precautions.
